title: The Settlement a Lapsed Funding Credit is Measured Against
content:
The settlement an Unattended Micro Market Program lapsed funding credit is measured against is read over a window that widens where more than one settlement charge stands on the agreement over the recent two months, the day of the month the market format is invoiced on settling how far it widens.

## Schedule

| Settlement charges over the two months to the day the credit is worked out | Day of the month the format is invoiced on | The settlement is read over |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 or more | 10 or later | those two months |
| 2 or more | 9 or earlier | the four months to that day |
| 1 or none | any | no such widening is made |

## Notes to the schedule

The multi-charge count is 2 settlement charges over the two months to the day the credit is worked out: exactly 2 meets it, 1 does not. The mid-month cycle day is the 10th: a format invoiced on the 10th, or on any later day of the month, is on or after it, and a format invoiced on the 8th is before it.

*Hypothetical.* An agreement on a format invoiced on the 18th of the month, carrying 2 settlement charges over the two months to the day the credit is worked out, reads the settlement over those two months. Were the same format invoiced on the 5th, the settlement would be read over the four months to that day. Carrying a single settlement charge over those two months, neither line is reached.
